note: Round 2 after the re-exploration the round-1 judges pointed at: every pin whose missing element was named now carries a source aimed at that element (FTC/States v. Deere for the dealer-only tool, Apple's current support page for the user-facing surprise, Play Integrity's Allow/Deny language for the refusal). Elements are declared so both rounds grade the same checklist.

pins.claim: Windows 10 end of support is gated on TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot, leaving pre-8th-generation hardware without a supported upgrade path
elements: Windows 10 support ends on a stated date
the successor OS requires TPM 2.0
that requirement excludes pre-8th-generation hardware

evidence.anchor: will reach end of support on October 14, 2025

pins.claim: iOS 10.2.1 and 11.2 reduced peak performance on iPhones with aged batteries without disclosing the change or offering an opt-out
elements: a shipped iOS update changed performance management
the change affected devices with aged batteries
the change was not disclosed at the time
no opt-out was offered

evidence.anchor: improves power management during peak workloads

pins.claim: Microcode updates from 0x125 to 0x132 address Vmin shift instability on 13th and 14th generation Core i9 processors, and the resulting electromigration damage cannot be reversed
elements: microcode revisions from 0x125 to 0x132 address Vmin shift
the affected parts are 13th/14th generation Core i9
the resulting damage cannot be reversed

pins.claim: The Play Integrity API lets an application refuse to run on a device whose OS build fails attestation, making continued function a vendor decision rather than a property of the hardware
elements: the API returns an integrity verdict about the device or build
an app may act on that verdict by denying access

pins.claim: HP Dynamic Security and Epson's waste-ink counter stop a printer from printing on a firmware condition rather than on physical failure
elements: HP shipped firmware that blocks third-party cartridges
the block is a firmware condition, not a physical failure

pins.claim: ECU software locks combined with DMCA 1201 anti-circumvention restrict repair of agricultural equipment to the manufacturer's technicians
elements: a software tool is required to perform all repairs
the manufacturer restricts that tool to its authorized dealers
DMCA 1201 anti-circumvention is the statutory frame for that restriction

evidence.anchor: only fully functional software repair tool

pins.claim: Recycle Mode permanently disables a functioning speaker after a countdown, and no factory reset can recover it
elements: Recycle Mode runs a countdown before acting
it permanently deactivates the device
the device cannot be reactivated

evidence.anchor: Recycle Mode is a state your device enters
